query:

D. Marcus
context:
[1] (about=Derek, episodic, t0 @2025-01-06T09:22:00) Strava says I averaged 4.2 km per day over the break (not including today). That's actually below my typical baseline. [6] (about=Marcus, episodic, t0 @2025-01-06T09:15:00) Happy new year everyone! Great turnout this morning, really pleased we got 12 of us out. Route felt good. Who's in for next Saturday? Planning to do the canal loop again, should take about 90 minutes at club pace. 🏃
[7] (about=Marcus, episodic, t3 @2025-01-20T09:05:00) Great canal loop this morning, 11 out. Post-run  -  we're trying the Arch Cafe for the first time as a group. Ahmed confirmed they do halal options. 9:45am, who's joining? 🍳

query:
Two members described scaling back their race distance targets due to physical constraints. Which member specifically described downgrading to the 10K because the half marathon no longer felt realistic at their current weekly mileage?

Options:
A. Marcus
B. Lionel
C. Greg
D. Bernard
context:
[1] (about=Lionel, episodic, t12 @2025-02-17T09:38:00) I've had to recalibrate my own race ambitions this season as well. I was hoping for a half in the autumn but at thirty miles a week it simply doesn't feel realistic anymore. Perhaps a 10K. One adjusts to where the body is.
[2] (about=Derek, episodic, t14 @2025-02-24T09:35:00) 22:14 at parkrun is a solid 5K baseline. Extrapolated, your marathon pace equivalent would put you around sub-4:10 territory. Worth factoring into your Riverside target.
[3] (about=Lionel, episodic, t4 @2025-01-20T09:14:00) About 32 miles. Down from the 50 I was doing before Christmas, to be fair. I've deliberately scaled back after the speed session flare. The frustrating thing is that Pheidippides ran from Marathon to Athens and nobody told him to do load management - though of course that didn't end well for him either.
[4] (about=Bernard, episodic, t10 @2025-02-10T09:52:00) Good morning. The reservoir section was well worth the extra kilometres. My GPS had 12.5. My long run last Sunday was 11.2km, first time I've pushed past ten miles since my cardiologist signed me off in January. No issues.
[5] (about=Tasha, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T09:14:00) Good run today. Parkfield works for me. Bernard  -  I think there's one gentle climb around the 7k mark but it's nothing major. T.
[6] (about=Lionel, episodic, t14 @2025-02-24T09:48:00) Yuki, very well done. The 5 to 10K progression is where many runners discover their real range.
[7] (about=Lionel, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T09:01:00) To be fair Marcus, I'd rather not do trail when the hamstring is being temperamental. I've been keeping the mileage down deliberately  -  this week I'm only doing 30-odd miles total and that's where it needs to stay for now.
[8] (about=Derek, episodic, t20 @2025-03-17T09:49:00) The data supports negative splits for this course profile  -  the km 7 incline makes a fast opening pace costly. Conservative start, progressive build is the correct approach.
[9] (about=Derek, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T09:41:00) Strava shows 10.4km at 5:41/km today. I've moved to gels for this training block - the real food approach was causing some gastric variance at tempo effort. Two SiS gels this morning, no issues. Worth flagging for anyone targeting spring races.
[10] (about=Marcus, episodic, t18 @2025-03-10T09:54:00) Good. Race strategy full debrief next week. Two weeks everyone  -  legs feeling good, keep it light and sharp. 🏃
agent_answer: B. Lionel — in the excerpt, Lionel says he was hoping for a half marathon but at thirty miles a week it “doesn’t feel realistic anymore,” so perhaps a 10K.
